tonight.headline: Up 28–1 with eight to play: Tate is 'definitely trending' toward playing, and London is under way
body: Bad news first. Saquon Barkley is on Philadelphia's inactive list in London and nobody has given a date for his return. You are 0–4 and last in a waiver order that never resets. Carnell Tate is still officially questionable, and this brief is written two hours before the list that settles it.

The morning's reporting is on your side. Jeremy Fowler has Tate 'definitely trending' toward playing. Lawrence and Tuten were not on Jacksonville's inactive list and kicked off at 07:30, forty minutes after this snapshot. You lead 28–1 on George Pickens's Thursday; ESPN has it 133.4 to 122.3 and 56%. Your lineup is the projection lineup. One check remains: at 09:30, if Tate is on the inactive list, Golden takes his slot.

case.label: Their side
case.body: Nacua 21.7, Goff 18.5, Kyren Williams 17.9, Jeremiyah Love 14.4, Watson 13.9, Kittle 13.7, and Tee Higgins, 12.8, in the flex and questionable. Cincinnati elevated no receiver on Saturday night, which a beat writer reads as leaving the door open for him to play. Love practised in full on Friday and is called good to go; Goff, Kittle and Watson are on no injury report read this morning. Arizona are without Marvin Harrison Jr. The Cowboys' defence is banked at 1 (archive).

case.label: Your side
case.body: Pickens 28.0, played. To come: Taylor 19.0, Lawrence 18.1, Wilson 14.7, Tuten 14.0, Tate 13.6, Loveland 9.7, Myers 8.7, the Jaguars 7.7. Lawrence, Tuten and the defence are playing in London as you read this.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Tate's name on the 09:30 inactive list, on your side. On theirs, Higgins sitting, which costs them about a point against their bench. An 11-point projected lead with eight players each to come is close to even.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · provisional until the inactive list · check Sun 09:30 Mexico City · both kick off 11:00
doFirst.title: 09:30: if Tate is inactive, Golden
doFirst.subtitle: Fowler, Sunday morning: 'definitely trending' toward playing. Still officially questionable and this is written before the list. Do nothing unless his name is on it; Golden plays at the same hour.

case.label: Where it stands
case.body: Limited on Thursday and Friday with the back and listed questionable. Jeremy Fowler of ESPN on Sunday morning: Tate is 'definitely trending' toward playing against Houston (RotoWire, 11 Oct; NFL.com's pregame tracker). Robert Saleh's 'good to go' still reaches you only through two posts by ESPN's Turron Davenport on Friday; there is no first-hand quote. Tennessee elevated no receiver.

case.label: Why he stays in
case.body: 13.6 against Golden's 12.8 is a coin flip and coin flips go to the projection. Tate faces Houston, who allow receivers the most points in the league; Golden faces Chicago, fifth-stingiest.

case.label: The fallback
case.body: Golden is not on Green Bay's report and kicks off at 11:00 like Tate, so the swap can wait for the list at 09:30.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Tate is active and Golden outscores him today (archive): then the coin flip lost, and no thesis was written on it. If Tate is inactive this card fires.

whatWentWrong.title: Tate is still officially questionable, two hours before the list
whatWentWrong.lead: The best report yet says he is 'definitely trending' toward playing. It is a report, not the inactive list, and this brief cannot see the list.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: Limited Thursday and Friday, questionable. Fowler on Sunday morning: 'definitely trending' toward playing. Saleh's view is still second-hand: Turron Davenport's Friday posts say Tate 'is good to go' and 'had some random tightness yesterday but is fine'.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: Nothing. The one card stays as a fallback with Golden named, and the decision is made from the inactive list.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: His name on the inactive list at 09:30 makes Golden the starter. His name missing from it ends the question.

worthALook.name: Marvin Harrison Jr.
worthALook.lead: The biggest riser on your wire and a free agent here. Fowler reported on Saturday night that people around the league believe he is going to Houston. Nothing is completed, and he is inactive today.

case.label: The news
case.body: Jeremy Fowler, Saturday night: 'multiple execs gauging the overall trade market as well as an Arizona player source believe Harrison Jr. will be a Houston Texan' (relayed by SI All Cardinals, 10 Oct 22:42 ET), with the deal expected early next week. Schefter had reported on Saturday that a trade was being finalised with an unnamed team. A second research pass, reading ESPN items from 9 Oct, found Arizona 'not shopping him'; the newer report is used.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 13 targets in four games: 3, 1, 5 and 4, for 4.3, 0.0, 7.0 and 8.2 (archive). ESPN projects 0.0 this week. Houston would put him beside Nico Collins with C.J. Stroud throwing, which is a better seat than Arizona's, but it is a belief and not a trade. He would take a seat from Golden or from a player protected by a teammate's injury.

case.label: When to act
case.body: When the trade is announced, and before Tuesday's claims if it is. He is a free agent, so adding him costs no priority. The drop is named then, not now.

worthALook.sources: SI All Cardinals (Fowler) · NBC Sports (Schefter) · Week 1–4 archive · ESPN league file

worthALook.name: Zach Charbonnet
worthALook.lead: New overnight: KEI returns dropped him for T.J. Hockenson and he is on waivers until Wednesday at 01:00. He has not played since tearing an ACL in January, and you are last in the order.

case.label: The role
case.body: Tore his left ACL on 17 January and is still on the physically-unable-to-perform list. Seattle opened his practice window on 1 Oct, so he must be activated by about 22 Oct or miss the season. He was limited on Friday and ruled out; the team's site says he 'is not yet ready to come off it'. Mike Macdonald on 5 Oct: 'We're down runners'. Emanuel Wilson is carrying the load and Joe Mixon was signed to the practice squad.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 0.0 this week, no target date from anyone, and a claim would have to beat nine managers from last place. If he clears on Wednesday he is free; if a rival claims him, nothing was lost that you could have won.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Clearing waivers on Wednesday with Seattle activating him: then he is a free add to weigh against Barkley's timetable. Seattle play on Thursday 15 Oct.

worthALook.sources: activity log · seahawks.com · Bleacher Report · Field Level Media · ESPN league file

worthALook.name: Roman Wilson
worthALook.lead: Free, and Pittman went on injured reserve on Saturday: out at least four games, back no sooner than Week 10. Wilson's targets did not move the last time he was missing.

case.label: The role
case.body: Pittsburgh put Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) on injured reserve on Saturday (Steelers Depot, 10 Oct 15:52 ET). Heavy expects Wilson and Germie Bernard to take his snaps and targets, a writer's read; no coach has said it. 14 catches for 188 and two touchdowns so far.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Six targets in all four games, the one without Pittman included (archive). 10.2, below Golden on your bench, so he would not start, and showers are certain in Pittsburgh with gusts to 26 mph. He is a free agent, which matters when you are last in the waiver order.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Eight or more targets against Indianapolis on Sunday. With Pittman gone for a month that would be a role and not a spike. Even then the seat is the problem: Rice and Barkley are both hurt but neither is out for long.

worthALook.sources: steelers.com · Steelers Depot · CBS · Week 1–4 archive · waiver_analysis.py

worthALook.lead: You held him for three hours on Wednesday. Free again, level with Loveland, and not a move.

case.label: The role
case.body: 7 catches on 8 targets for a career-high 95 in Week 4 with every Jacksonville pass-catcher healthy (archive). Targets 3, 2, 5, 8. Not on London's inactive list, and playing as this is written.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 9.7, the same as Loveland, for a seat that changed twice on Wednesday. Jacksonville are off in Week 7; Loveland has no bye until Week 10.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Loveland ruled out. Nothing else reopens the seat before 14 Oct.

worthALook.name: Will Shipley
worthALook.lead: The handcuff to your Barkley, who is inactive in London. Shipley leads Philadelphia's backfield this morning, against your own defence.

case.label: The role
case.body: Barkley is on the inactive list (philadelphiaeagles.com, 11 Oct 08:05 ET) and Tank Bigsby is on injured reserve after core-muscle surgery, out until at least Week 9. The Eagles' site has Shipley leading the backfield, with Dameon Pierce and Carson Steele behind him. ESPN projects Shipley 10.2.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: No coach has given a split, and Pierce and Carson Steele are both on the 53. 15 carries all season (archive). 10.2 is below Tuten, Kamara and Gordon, behind a line starting Willie Lampkin, Jake Majors and rookie Markel Bell, and he would be running against your own defence at 07:30 on Sunday.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Barkley going on injured reserve. Then the seat question is asked again, and the only unprotected seat is Golden's, who is not a drop for a handcuff.

doNotChase.name: Mike Washington Jr.
doNotChase.lead: Still the second-biggest riser. Rapoport this morning: Jeanty is hopeful to play, not definite. A one-week back you have no slot for.

case.label: The rise
case.body: Ashton Jeanty (ankle and foot) was limited on Thursday, did not practise on Friday and is questionable. Ian Rapoport on Sunday morning: hopeful to play at New England, availability not definite, with a pregame workout to decide (NFL.com tracker; RotoWire, 11 Oct). Washington, a fourth-round rookie with 24 carries for 120 this season, would lead if Jeanty sits; Las Vegas elevated Roman Hemby on Saturday.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 9 carries for 18 in Week 4 and a season-high 21% of the snaps (archive; DraftKings Network). Even as a starter he would sit behind Taylor and Tuten here, your flex has already scored 28.0, and the only seats belong to players protected by a teammate's injury or to Golden.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Jeanty ruled out for several weeks. One missed game changes nothing for this roster.

doNotChase.sources: raiders.com · PFT · Athlon · The Big Lead · Week 4 archive

doNotChase.name: Jacoby Brissett
doNotChase.lead: Rising on a matchup, not a role, and he is without a starting receiver today. He still projects half a point under Lawrence.

case.label: The rise
case.body: Detroit have allowed the most points to quarterbacks through Week 4 (FootballDB, re-read 10 Oct) and the game's total is the week's highest, 54.5, with Detroit favoured by 5.5; the game is in Arizona. He is a free agent, so he would cost no priority. Nothing dated this week names Arizona's starter beyond a 5 Oct 'No' to a change.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 17.6 against Lawrence's 18.1: the projection preferred the quarterback you have, and Lawrence's game has begun, so the question is closed for this week. Marvin Harrison Jr. is inactive with a trade pending, news that came after the 17.6 was set.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing this week. Next week it is asked again from the projections.

doNotChase.sources: FootballDB · CBS · NBC Sports · ESPN league file

doNotChase.name: Malik Washington
doNotChase.lead: Steady targets, and a sixth receiver here.

case.label: The rise
case.body: Caleb Douglas (ankle) and tight end Justin Joly are out for Miami (miamidolphins.com, 9 Oct). Five or more targets in every game (archive targets 8, 5, 10, 5). Nothing dated Sunday mentions him.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Targets 8, 5, 10, 5 (archive) in an offence that ran 37 plays last week. 11.0, below Wilson, Tate, Pickens and Golden.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Eight or more targets against Cincinnati, or a different quarterback in Miami.

doNotChase.name: Mark Andrews
doNotChase.lead: Lamar Jackson is ruled out. Tyler Huntley throws to him on Sunday night.

case.label: The rise
case.body: The steadiest targets of the free tight ends: 6, 7, 5, 6 (archive). He practised in full on Friday and has no designation.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Lamar Jackson is out and Jesse Minter says of Tyler Huntley: ''Snoop' has done a great job this week... I expect him to play really well' (baltimoreravens.com, 9 Oct 12:46). 9.6, level with Loveland, for a closed seat; Zay Flowers is questionable too.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Jackson's return, which Rapoport gives a 'real chance' for Week 6, together with Loveland being ruled out.

doNotChase.name: Makai Lemon
doNotChase.lead: Smith and Brown are officially out, which is a real reason. He has not passed six points in a game.

case.label: The rise
case.body: DeVonta Smith and Hollywood Brown are on the inactive list in London; Dontayvion Wicks plays and Dallas Goedert returns (philadelphiaeagles.com, 11 Oct 08:05 ET).

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 3 catches on 6 targets for 27, 5.7, with Smith already out; 2.5, 1.9 and 5.9 before that (archive). And he would be catching passes against your own defence.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Eight or more targets in London.

waiverAnalysis.summary: Eight names clear the tool's bar, and at running back and receiver the bar is an artefact: it measures them against Barkley and Rice, whose last week was an injury exit each. Four weeks of data. Changed since Saturday: Worthy replaces Shakir on the list. None is a move: you are last in the waiver order and no seat is open.

rising.name: Keaton Mitchell
rising.roleReason: A three-man rotation with Omarion Hampton and Kimani Vidal; he led it with 15 touches to Hampton's 11 in Week 4 and his touches have risen every week, but RotoWire still calls it a committee and the coach said on Friday the depth chart has not changed. Ladd McConkey is not expected to play today (Schefter). Off in Week 7.
rising.action: WATCH — a committee third whose coach says the depth chart has not changed; the trigger is Hampton missing a game

rising.name: Brian Robinson Jr.
rising.roleReason: Bijan Robinson is healthy. Brian Robinson has had 10 or more carries in three straight games, 11, 10 and 14, and his 25.7 last week was three touchdowns (archive; RotoWire, 5 Oct). Nothing new on Sunday.
rising.action: WATCH — touchdowns behind a healthy starter

rising.name: MarShawn Lloyd
rising.roleReason: Chris Brooks is on injured reserve, which leaves Lloyd and Kaleb Johnson; Lloyd ran 7 times for 13 in Week 4 and averages 2.7 yards a carry, and Green Bay rank last in rushing efficiency (A to Z Sports, 7 Oct). Two guards are doubtful. Nothing newer than 13 Sep was found on Josh Jacobs's exempt-list status. You dropped Lloyd for Gordon.
rising.action: WATCH — one fewer back behind him, but volume at under two yards a carry behind a line missing two guards
rising.sources: SI Packers On SI · packers.com · Week 4 archive

rising.name: Mike Washington Jr.
rising.roleReason: Ashton Jeanty is hopeful to play and not definite (Rapoport, 11 Oct), with a pregame workout to decide. Washington leads if he sits. 9 carries for 18 in Week 4 (archive).
rising.action: WATCH — a one-week starter at most, with no slot here behind Taylor and Tuten

rising.name: Tyquan Thornton
rising.roleReason: Out 12 to 16 weeks after ankle surgery, as reported on 5 Oct and carried; nothing new was found today. The tool still prints him because his last game was his biggest.
rising.action: WATCH — off the list: out until at least January

rising.name: Xavier Worthy
rising.roleReason: New on the tool's list today. Tyquan Thornton is out 12 to 16 weeks after ankle surgery and Rashee Rice left Week 4 with a hamstring, which is where Worthy's 28% target share that week came from (archive). Rice's injury is 'more of a tweak' and he may not miss a game (Rapoport, 7 Oct); the Chiefs are reported 'very interested' in Tyreek Hill. Kansas City are on bye.
rising.action: WATCH — on waivers until Monday 01:00 and you are last in the order; you already hold Rice from the same offence

rising.name: Keon Coleman
rising.roleReason: 6 catches on 7 targets for 116 after DJ Moore left (archive). Moore was limited on Saturday and is questionable for Monday; Joshua Palmer is out. Nothing new on Sunday.
rising.action: WATCH — a role that exists only while Moore is out
rising.sources: NBC Sports · Democrat and Chronicle · Week 4 archive

rising.name: Roman Wilson
rising.roleReason: Michael Pittman Jr. is on injured reserve, back no sooner than Week 10; Mike McCarthy called it 'a multiple-week injury'. Wilson has drawn exactly six targets in each of four games, the one without Pittman included (archive).
rising.action: WATCH — a month-long vacancy now and, so far, a flat six targets; he is free, so waiting costs no priority

settled.result: philadelphiaeagles.com, published the same afternoon, expects Shipley 'to be the primary back'. It matters to your Jaguars defence, and the brief used one source when the team's own was available.

settled.result: Not fired and nothing new: questionable, and reported good to go. The card is carried to Sunday's inactive list.

settled.result: Ruled out on Friday and not placed on injured reserve. He was on your bench at 0.0 all week, with Tuten in his slot.

settled.result: Lamb's quad is a bruise, not considered serious, and he should play in Week 6 (Rapoport). The caution stands.

settled.result: Live archive: 28.0 on 9 catches from 13 targets, 130 yards and a touchdown. Golden plays on Sunday, so the comparison is not finished; no thesis was written on it either way.

settled.title: 'Put in the claim for George Pickens' (Wednesday's first card)
settled.result: It won, cost the priority, 7th to 10th, and his first game for you scored 28.0. Graded over Weeks 5 to 7 against Downs, who plays on Sunday. One game; the log entry stays open.

settled.title: 'Nobody has explained Tate's back' (Thursday afternoon)
settled.result: It was explainable within hours: a beat writer watched him tweak it in individual drills. The brief did not find that on Thursday.

settled.result: Done at 08:44 on Thursday. 14.0 against 10.9; graded on Sunday against Gordon's score.

settled.result: It did not fail. Six managers ahead of you passed on a receiver 99% rostered. The forecast was wrong; the recommendation stood either way.

settled.result: Done at 12:40 on Wednesday. 4.9 out, 7.7 in. Graded on Sunday against the Ravens' score.

settled.result: You swapped Strange for Loveland at 13:06 on Wednesday. Both project 9.7. Graded on Sunday: the order is wrong if Loveland outscores Strange, and the second move was churn either way.

settled.title: Week 4 final: 63.7 to 78.2
settled.result: Kyle Pitts added 7.7 for Team 13 on Monday (archive). You lost by 14.5. Kamara 22.8, Tate 21.5, Gordon 18.0 and Golden 11.7 on the bench would have scored 61.7 more than the four slots they could have filled. Barkley and Rice were injury exits; the rest was the projection's lineup.

settled.result: Archive: Downs 4.6, Tate 21.5. A coin flip by projection with no thesis written, and it lost by 16.9.

settled.result: You added him. Archive: Waller 6.6, Sadiq 0.0. Your move won the week; four days later you dropped him on his bye.

settled.result: Archive: 18.0 on the bench. The lean was mine and it is withdrawn. He projects 10.9 this week and is on your bench behind Tuten, where the projection puts him.
